findings_json.description: Untrusted input is used in asyncio.create_subprocess_shell() or manipulated asynchronously.
findings_json.evidence:
8:     # safe command but shell=True is insecure; bandit will flag
→ 9:     subprocess.call("echo 'listing files' && dir", shell=True)
  10:

taint_trace.description: Pattern: subprocess.call("echo 'listing files' && dir", shell=True) uses shell=True -- shell command injection possible regardless of argument source

findings_json.remediation: Use asyncio.create_subprocess_exec() instead of shell(), and ensure arguments are passed safely as a list, never concatenated as strings.
